{{Quote|Chiss brought in from outside a Family's bloodlines to enrich or diversify or invigorate. All warriors are made merit adoptives when they're accepted into either the Defense Fleet or the Expansionary Fleet. That's why every warrior wears the color of one of the Families.''"<br />"''Which one is yours?''"<br />"''The Eighth.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo, to [[Maris Ferasi]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
The '''Mitth family''',<ref name="Chasing Copero" /> also called '''House Mitth''',<ref name="TEA" /> and formerly known as the '''Eighth Ruling Family''' or '''Eighth Family''', was a [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss family]] in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It was once one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Nine Ruling Families]]. Every [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Ruling Family was associated with a specific [[Color/Legends|color]], and that of the Eighth Ruling Family was burgundy.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

At some later date, it appears that Thrawn likewise became a Syndic of the Family,<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> as in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Vision of the Future Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] encountered warriors from his [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Household Phalanx]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]], identifying themselves as warriors serving "Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo", and wearing the burgundy [[Chiss family uniform|uniforms]] of the Family.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], the number of Ruling Families was still said to be nine, although it was not said explicitly that the designation of Eighth Ruling Family was still borne by the same affinity.<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> By [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="Force Heretic II Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> the number of Ruling Families in the Ascendancy had been reduced to four, and the Mitth family was not mentioned as one of them.<ref name="Dark Nest I">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> Despite her claim of being an [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] of the Expansionary Defense Force, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hess'irolia'nuruodo]] wore a burgundy-and-black uniform,<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> a color scheme previously associated with the Mitth family<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn's rogue [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household Phalanx]].<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Excluding Thrawn, whose appearances date back to the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'',<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Chiss associated with the Eighth Ruling Family first appeared in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]''.<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> However, the family designation of "Mitth" was not used until the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The name "Mitth family" was first definitively used in the [[2017]] short story "Chasing Copero" from the official website of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Chasing Copero" />
